# dont

> Rust CLI for forcing epistemic discipline in autonomous LLM workflows. Gives agents an explicit state machine for claims and terms so ungrounded assertions don't quietly become accepted project truth.

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

Leer en español: https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/

## Install

macOS & Linux via curl (latest release binary):

```bash
V=$(basename "$(curl -fsSLI -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' \
  https://github.com/charly-vibes/dont/releases/latest)" | sed 's/^v//')
TGT="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')_$(uname -m | sed 's/^x86_64$/amd64/; s/^aarch64$/arm64/')"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/charly-vibes/dont/releases/download/v${V}/dont_${V}_${TGT}.tar.gz" | tar xz
chmod +x dont && sudo mv dont /usr/local/bin/
```

Also: `brew tap charly-vibes/charly && brew install dont` or `cargo install dont-cli`.
